div.head: Abt 30
div.ab: Gif man mannan ofslea, agene scætte ⁊ unfacne feo gehwilce gelde.
Gif man mannan ofslea, agene scætte ⁊ unfacne feo gehwilce gelde.
If a person should kill someone, let him pay [with] his own money or unblemished property, whichever.
If one man slays another, he shall pay the wergeld with his own money and property (i.e. livestock or other goods) which whatever its nature must be free from blemish [or damage].
If anyone kill a man, he is to pay with his own money and unblemished goods, whatever their kind.
Wenn jemand einen Menschen erschlägt, zahle er [an dessen Sippe das Wergeld] aus eigenem Schatze und mit makelloser Fahrhabe, welcher auch immer.
If someone slays a person, let him pay [the wergeld to the latter’s kin] from his own treasure and in flawless movable goods, of whatever kind.
